description: US interstate movers and their household-goods complaint history from FMCSA's Protect Your Move search. By USDOT or MC number: name, numbers, address, phone, fleet, safety rating, authority types and complaints per year for the last four years by category (estimates, hostage goods, loss/damage, insurance...). By name or state: matching registered movers with location, fleet size and USDOT id. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

dot.description: USDOT number for the full record with complaints

mc.description: MC docket number for the full record with complaints
